scope: Isolated release library build, not validation or a performance comparison. Replaces the incomplete six-library bundle for subsequent audits; candidate and baseline dependency search paths must remain separate.
source_identity: Every extracted file comes from git archive of the recorded revision and was hashed before/after the successful build. The source manifest includes extra workspace targets because Cargo validates their declared paths even for a library-only build.
preparatory_failures: First extraction omitted declared example/bench sources, causing manifest parsing failures.
A larger extraction hit the command argument limit; extraction now batches 500 paths.
The first native C build could not write the default ccache; the completed build uses its own writable ccache directory.
